tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch6.label: Chapter 6
card.ch6.title: Options
end.ch6.title: End of Chapter 6
end.ch6.body:
The Hero knows two words: "Options" and "Forward". It's a start.
In Chapter 7 we go down to the bottom of the page. Right to the bottom.
rule.sign: The "Silence" sign is printed at {} volume.
page.p20.title: Hero options
page.p20.intro: Factory settings of the Hero, basic model. Do not change without supervision.
page.p21.title: Controls
page.p21.intro: Main controls of GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE.
page.p22.title: The chapter 7 door
page.p22.intro: The door only opens for whoever says the password. Out loud.
n.i1: The Corridor of Levels. The chapter 7 door is at the end.
n.i2: I've brought the Hero. It's his first mission. Let's hope it's also his last.
n.i3: Yes, yes. Your options are on page 20. But nobody touches them.
n.i4: Direction: backwards. Courage: off. Voice: mute. Factory settings. Perfect as they are.
n.empty1: A corridor. It's for getting from one chapter to another. In theory.
n.empty2: Nothing there. The corridor was furnished on a tight budget.
n.tool1: The arrows won't help here. A Hero will. Unfortunately.
n.typo_level: "Levle". Level 6 got its letters in a muddle.
n.lamp_off: The chandelier is off. The Hero's courage borrowed it.
n.frames: Pictures of past levels. Level 3 came out nicely. Level 5, let's not talk about it.
n.at_door: He's reached the door. Now he just has to say the password. Out loud.
n.bump1: He walked backwards and bumped into the wall. Direction: BACKWARDS. As per the manual.
n.bump2: Into the wall again. Elegantly, at least.
n.scared: He's stopped. The ink puddle scares him. Courage: OFF, says page 20.
n.scared2: He won't cross. He's trembling. His courage is off.
n.walk1: He's walking! Forward! With his head on backwards, but forward!
n.walk2: He jumped the puddle. A brave Hero. In the dark, but brave.
n.door_open: The chapter 7 door is open. There's a whiff of footnotes.
n.whisper: He whispered it. The door didn't hear. Volume: MUTE.
n.door_far: The door is over there. The Hero is over here. He needs walking there.
n.s1: The door opens! The password was OPTIONS. The only word he knows. What outrageous luck.
n.s2: ...He said "Forward". He said a NEW word!
p.6: he read it on page 21. reading is good for you.
n.s3: He learned a word from a manual. Like all of us, really.
n.rx_forward: Direction: FORWARD. Tap him and let's see what happens. I'll stand back.
n.rx_brave: Courage: ON! And the chandelier... off. Courage in the dark. Very heroic.
n.rx_loud: Volume LOUD. Please, nobody give him a microphone.
n.rx_cmd_back: "To advance, press BACKWARDS". At last, an honest manual.
n.rx_odd: Now the options make no sense. Like most options, really.
h.walk.1: The Hero's head is on backwards and he walks backwards. His options are on page 20.
h.walk.2: On page 21 the controls use a very useful word for walking.
h.walk.3: Swap FORWARD (page 21) with BACKWARDS (page 20), then tap the Hero.
h.courage.1: The Hero is scared of the ink puddle. Check his courage.
h.courage.2: Courage is OFF. On page 21 something else is ON.
h.courage.3: Swap ON (page 21) with OFF (page 20), then tap the Hero.
h.shout.1: The door wants to hear the password. The Hero only knows one word.
h.shout.2: The Hero's volume is MUTE. On page 22 something is printed LOUD.
h.shout.3: Swap LOUD (page 22) with MUTE (page 20), then tap the door.
